501.translation: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down
And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

502.translation: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

503.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
For those who swear not to have sexual relations with their wives is a waiting time of four months, but if they return [to normal relations] - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

504.translation: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."

505.translation: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].
Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.

506.translation: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,

507.translation: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it [i.e., punishment] would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
For you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.

508.translation: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

509.translation: But if they turn away, then indeed - Allāh is Knowing of the corrupters.
He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."

510.translation: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
Then do not obey the deniers.

511.translation: Those will have a share of what they have earned, and Allāh is swift in account.
Whom Allāh has cursed. For he had said, "I will surely take from among Your servants a specific portion.

512.translation: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
And We removed from you your burden

513.translation: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allāh for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?
For wrongdoing on the part of the Jews, We made unlawful for them [certain] good foods which had been lawful to them, and for their averting from the way of Allāh many [people],

514.translation: And fear the Fire, which has been prepared for the disbelievers.
Indeed, Allāh has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze.

515.translation: So I swear by the retreating stars -
So I swear by the twilight glow

516.translation: Then, did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them at night while they were asleep?
They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors?

517.translation: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation
Then We produced after them a generation of others.

518.translation: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -
Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

519.translation: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

519.gloss: And surely We will test you
519.translation: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allāh] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.

520.translation: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.

521.translation: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].

522.translation: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel
Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

523.translation: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

524.translation: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.

525.translation: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].
But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

526.translation: The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allāh], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.
And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.

527.translation: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. And he will have failed who carries injustice.

528.translation: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

529.translation: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
Know that Allāh is severe in penalty and that Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

530.translation: Then We will surely relate [their deeds] to them with knowledge, and We were not [at all] absent.
That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down].

531.translation: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous."

532.translation: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

533.translation: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

534.translation: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

535.translation: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

536.translation: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
[And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

537.translation: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
[Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."

538.translation: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

539.translation: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord
And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."

540.translation: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
And He sent against them birds in flocks,

541.translation: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

542.translation: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
He has sent down upon you, [O Muḥammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel

543.translation: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

544.translation: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.

545.translation: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

546.translation: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
They will not harm you except for [some] annoyance. And if they fight you, they will show you their backs [i.e., retreat]; then they will not be aided.

547.translation: They were satisfied to be with those who stay behind, and their hearts were sealed over, so they do not understand.
That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.

548.translation: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.
Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.

549.translation: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.

550.translation: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
And Allāh knows what you conceal and what you declare.

551.translation: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

552.translation: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

553.translation: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
Untouched before them by man or jinnī -

554.translation: Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on.
Allāh has pardoned you, [O Muḥammad, but] why did you give them permission [to remain behind]? [You should not have] until it was evident to you who were truthful and you knew [who were] the liars.

555.translation: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel
But how is it that they come to you for judgement while they have the Torah, in which is the judgement of Allāh? Then they turn away, [even] after that; but those are not [in fact] believers.

556.translation: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason [i.e., the disbelievers].

557.translation: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].

558.translation: They are [varying] degrees in the sight of Allāh, and Allāh is Seeing of whatever they do.
Degrees [of high position] from Him and forgiveness and mercy. And Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

559.translation: Do you approach males among the worlds
Is the male for you and for Him the female?

560.translation: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
So remind, if the reminder should benefit;

561.translation: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

562.translation: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allāh -
Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?

563.translation: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

564.translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

565.translation: And then We would have given them from Us a great reward.
And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh

566.translation: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

567.translation: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

568.translation: But Allāh is your protector, and He is the best of helpers.
But if they turn away - then know that Allāh is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

569.translation: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

570.gloss: That He may give them in full
570.translation: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.

571.translation: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
He [i.e., Allāh] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.

572.translation: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
And what can make you know what is Saqar?

573.translation: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].

574.translation: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."

575.translation: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.

576.translation: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

577.translation: And they [i.e., Pharaoh and his people] were overcome right there and became debased.
And return to his people in happiness.

578.translation: And filling with it your bellies
Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

579.translation: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
Or has He daughters while you have sons?

580.translation: They said, "[It is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams."
And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.

581.translation: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."

582.translation: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

583.translation: And We certainly seized the people of Pharaoh with years of famine and a deficiency in fruits that perhaps they would be reminded.
And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient,

584.translation: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.

585.translation: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

586.translation: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.

587.translation: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

588.translation: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?

589.translation: And thus do We [explain in] detail the verses, and perhaps they will return.
And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident.

590.translation: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.
He said, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire for you as a god while He has preferred you over the worlds?"

591.translation: And those who are in their testimonies upright
And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]

592.translation: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.
And Allāh will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."

593.translation: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

595.translation: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.

596.translation: Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] no madness. He is not but a clear warner.

[We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.

597.translation: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

598.translation: They want to extinguish the light of Allāh with their mouths, but Allāh refuses except to perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.
That Allāh may forgive for you what preceded of your sin [i.e., errors] and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path

599.translation: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.

600.translation: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allāh.

601.translation: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.
And there is for you in legal retribution [saving of] life, O you [people] of understanding, that you may become righteous.

602.translation: And caused to grow within it grain
And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

603.translation: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
[Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"

604.translation: And if they cease, then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock –

605.translation: Indeed, your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing.
Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."

606.translation: Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.

607.translation: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
And We certainly gave David from Us bounty. [We said], "O mountains, repeat [Our] praises with him, and the birds [as well]." And We made pliable for him iron,

608.translation: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."

609.translation: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

610.translation: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
[That is Our] established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration.

611.translation: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

612.translation: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.

613.translation: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest

614.translation: Say, "In the bounty of Allāh and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."
[The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.

616.translation: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

617.translation: And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully.

And when [other] relatives and orphans and the needy are present at the [time of] division, then provide for them [something] out of it [i.e., the estate] and speak to them words of appropriate kindness.

618.translation: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
To Allāh is your return, and He is over all things competent."

619.translation: And do not confer favor to acquire more
And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,

620.translation: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

621.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and those who have emigrated and fought in the cause of Allāh - those expect the mercy of Allāh. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

The ones who have believed, emigrated and striven in the cause of Allāh with their wealth and their lives are greater in rank in the sight of Allāh. And it is those who are the attainers [of success].

622.translation: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

623.translation: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

624.translation: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

625.translation: And We do not delay it except for a limited term.
A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

626.translation: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
And that it is He who enriches and suffices

627.translation: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].

628.translation: And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.

And the two who commit it [i.e., unlawful sexual intercourse] among you - punish [i.e., dishonor] them both. But if they repent and correct themselves, leave them alone. Indeed, Allāh is ever Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.

629.translation: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
Cursed were those who disbelieved among the Children of Israel by the tongue of David and of Jesus, the son of Mary. That was because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed.

630.translation: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."

631.translation: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
But if they turn away, [O Muḥammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.

632.translation: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

633.translation: [This is] a Book revealed to you, [O Muḥammad] - so let there not be in your breast distress therefrom - that you may warn thereby and as a reminder to the believers.

But no, by your Lord, they will not [truly] believe until they make you, [O Muḥammad], judge concerning that over which they dispute among themselves and then find within themselves no discomfort from what you have judged and submit in [full, willing] submission.

634.translation: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allāh].

635.translation: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all."

636.translation: And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
And out of His mercy He made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from His bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful.

637.translation: And have you seen the water that you drink?
A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

638.translation: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.

639.translation: So be patient with gracious patience.
He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.

640.translation: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.

641.translation: And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned."
Why do the rabbis and religious scholars not forbid them from saying what is sinful and devouring what is unlawful? How wretched is what they have been practicing.

642.translation: Which had weighed upon your back
But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

643.translation: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land.

644.translation: And they [i.e., Pharaoh and his people] were overcome right there and became debased.
They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

645.translation: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes, it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged.

646.translation: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.
Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"

647.translation: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

648.translation: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
Say, "Allāh has told the truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of the polytheists."

649.translation: So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
They said, "We are missing the measure of the king. And for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and I am responsible for it."

650.translation: And We had already sent among them warners.
Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners

651.translation: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim [submitting to Allāh]. And he was not of the polytheists.
They say, "Be Jews or Christians [so] you will be guided." Say, "Rather, [we follow] the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth, and he was not of the polytheists."

652.translation: Allāh warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.
They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

653.translation: Not upon the Messenger is [responsibility] except [for] notification. And Allāh knows whatever you reveal and whatever you conceal.
Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allāh is ever, of all things, Knowing.

654.translation: He will be judged with an easy account

655.translation: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
[Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.

656.translation: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.
O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."

657.translation: [It is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.
Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in His promise."

658.translation: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
Those are the disbelievers, truly. And We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment.

659.translation: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

660.translation: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

661.translation: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.
And of the people is he who sells himself, seeking means to the approval of Allāh. And Allāh is Kind to [His] servants.

662.translation: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

663.translation: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
[He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].

664.translation: And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger and transgresses His limits - He will put him into the Fire to abide eternally therein, and he will have a humiliating punishment.
The bedouins are stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy and more likely not to know the limits of what [laws] Allāh has revealed to His Messenger. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

665.translation: And untie the knot from my tongue
To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."

666.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
They who are during their prayer humbly intent

667.translation: Rather, worship [only] Allāh and be among the grateful.
[He was] grateful for His favors. He [i.e., Allāh] chose him and guided him to a straight path.

668.translation: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.

669.translation: He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allāh] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment.
So his Lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

670.translation: And He found you lost and guided [you],
Indeed they found their fathers astray.

671.translation: And a shade of black smoke,
Nor are the shade and the heat,

672.translation: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
And among those We created is a community which guides by truth and thereby establishes justice.

673.translation: And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can alter His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Indeed, Allāh orders justice and good conduct and giving [help] to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

674.translation: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.
Indeed, those who took the calf [for worship] will obtain anger from their Lord and humiliation in the life of this world, and thus do We recompense the inventors [of falsehood].

675.translation: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.

676.translation: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.

677.translation: If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins and admit you to a noble entrance [into Paradise].
And if only the People of the Scripture had believed and feared Allāh, We would have removed from them their misdeeds and admitted them to Gardens of Pleasure.

678.translation: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."

679.translation: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.
O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [in battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight].

680.translation: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.
He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."

681.translation: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].

683.translation: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
Those are the disbelievers, truly. And We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment.

684.translation: And do not marry those [women] whom your fathers married, except what has already occurred. Indeed, it was an immorality and hateful [to Allāh] and was evil as a way.

The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.

685.translation: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

686.translation: And We certainly showed him [i.e., Pharaoh] Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
Except Iblees; he refused to be with those who prostrated.

687.gloss: surely, He (would) have made them hear
687.translation: Had Allāh known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing.
And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear [i.e., benefit from this hearing], although they will not use reason?

688.translation: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
Nor did we used to feed the poor.

689.translation: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
And Allāh has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He [i.e., Allāh] is but one God, so fear only Me."

690.translation: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.

691.translation: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

692.translation: But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied [i.e., unfailing]."

693.translation: There the authority is [completely] for Allāh, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
So Allāh gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the Hereafter. And Allāh loves the doers of good.

694.translation: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
[Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].

695.translation: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
And they who guard their private parts

696.translation: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
And when he goes away, he strives throughout the land to cause corruption therein and destroy crops and animals. And Allāh does not like corruption.

697.translation: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.

698.translation: Their Lord gives them good tidings of mercy from Him and approval and of gardens for them wherein is enduring pleasure.
That is because they followed what angered Allāh and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

699.translation: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"
And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allāh, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]?"

700.translation: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

701.translation: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.

702.translation: Kind speech and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury. And Allāh is Free of need and Forbearing.
And among them are some who criticize you concerning the [distribution of] charities. If they are given from them, they approve; but if they are not given from them, at once they become angry.

703.translation: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

704.translation: Even if we should be decayed bones?"
Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

705.translation: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

706.translation: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it
By the night when it covers

707.translation: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
[The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."

708.translation: And [remember] when you, [O Muḥammad], left your family in the morning to post the believers at their stations for the battle [of Uḥud] - and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing -
And Allāh repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allāh for the believers in battle, and ever is Allāh Powerful and Exalted in Might.

709.translation: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

710.translation: And when the earth has been extended
[But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.

711.translation: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allāh would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?
In their hearts is disease, so Allāh has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.

712.translation: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

713.translation: Indeed, We established him upon the earth, and We gave him from everything a way [i.e., means].
And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful.

714.translation: By the star when it descends,
And the stars and trees prostrate.

715.translation: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.

716.translation: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,
Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

717.translation: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

718.translation: So when he [i.e., her husband] saw his shirt torn from the back, he said, "Indeed, it is of your [i.e., women's] plan. Indeed, your plan is great [i.e., vehement].
But if you should desire Allāh and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allāh has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward."

719.translation: And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."
And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

720.translation: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome

721.translation: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?
It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

722.translation: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].
Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason [i.e., the disbelievers].

723.translation: And Allāh knows what you conceal and what you declare.
And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

724.translation: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
They want to extinguish the light of Allāh with their mouths, but Allāh will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.

725.gloss: And We caused to inherit them
725.translation: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

726.translation: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
So how [will it be] when disaster strikes them because of what their hands have put forth and then they come to you swearing by Allāh, "We intended nothing but good conduct and accommodation."

727.translation: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.

728.translation: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.

729.translation: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel
And let the People of the Gospel judge by what Allāh has revealed therein. And whoever does not judge by what Allāh has revealed - then it is those who are the defiantly disobedient.

730.translation: Those who believe in Allāh and the Last Day would not ask permission of you to be excused from striving [i.e., fighting] with their wealth and their lives. And Allāh is Knowing of those who fear Him.
And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

731.translation: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
Indeed, Allāh chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of ʿImrān over the worlds -

732.translation: Allāh begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.
Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

733.translation: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
Or do they say [about Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit."

734.translation: And had not known what is my account.
And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."

735.translation: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Wise.

736.translation: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allāh.
And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.

737.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Do you argue with us about Allāh while He is our Lord and your Lord? For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. And we are sincere [in deed and intention] to Him."
O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason?

738.translation: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.
Those who denied Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter - their deeds have become worthless. Are they recompensed except for what they used to do?

739.translation: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
[Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."

740.translation: And they swear by Allāh that they are from among you while they are not from among you; but they are a people who are afraid.
So how [will it be] when disaster strikes them because of what their hands have put forth and then they come to you swearing by Allāh, "We intended nothing but good conduct and accommodation."

741.translation: And [commanded], 'Direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allāh;
Say, "Allāh has told the truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of the polytheists."

742.translation: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -
Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

743.translation: And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the Qur’ān] increases them in humble submission.
The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

744.translation: He has succeeded who purifies it,
Have you not seen those who claim themselves to be pure? Rather, Allāh purifies whom He wills, and injustice is not done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside a date seed].

745.translation: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

745.gloss: They will be given to drink
745.translation: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

746.translation: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
[And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

747.translation: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.

748.translation: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.
But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].

749.translation: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].

750.translation: So as for he who transgressed
That you not transgress within the balance.
